svarogs dream a storyfocused openworld arpg inspired by slavic mythology premise awakened by the gods you are a soul drafted into the pantheons war against the onegod steam key features unique setting the world of svarogs dream is inspired by slavic mythology featuring popular creatures from slavic folklore such as baba yaga vukodlak and deities from the slavic pantheon the uniqueness of the setting is further expanded by the central conflict between the slavic pantheon and the onegod an entity inspired by the christian god the expansion improves this further by adding biblically accurate angels as enemies all of this creates a distinctive and memorable world exploration most of the game world is open to exploration from the start similar to sacred gold this is a continuous world rather than a hubanddungeon system the world isnt as huge as sacred though the world map features a fog of war that recedes as you progress through the story but it does not restrict where you can go beyond its openness the world is dense with discoveries such as powerful items elusive quest givers optional bosses and secret texts that reveal the weaknesses of formidable enemies this last element is very well done for example one optional boss is invulnerable while standing on his hill luring him away is impossible but hidden notes reveal that he leaves the hill at a specific time you might stumble upon this moment by chance while exploring or uncover it deliberately through the knowledge gained from notes that you also discover while exploring all of this makes the world very satisfying to explore character selection you are a spirit without a physical form that possesses other people this concept is reflected in character creation where instead of creating a new character you choose from predefined ones this is similar to selecting a class but each character comes with flavor text that ties them to the game world while the characters are technically classless their stat distributions hint at the playstyles they are best suited for the first three selectable characters not only have flavor text but also feature backstories connected to unique side quests for example the lady character that you can select has a revenge mission that is unique to her unique reincarnation mechanic the game features an optional reincarnation mechanic if your current vessel the character you possess dies it dies permanently and you must repossess a different one by selecting from a new set of characters upon death you lose your talents but your overall progress remains as the new character is scaled to match your previous level this mechanic can be turned off doing so provides a more traditional arpg experience with standard death and respawn wherein you dont permanently loose the character that you selected multiclassing the game features 12 classes and players can initially choose skills from two of them as you progress through the story or gain enough levels you can unlock the ability to select a third class unique passive system talents are passive abilities that develop as you progress through the game and interact with the world or perform certain actions for example crafting a potion might unlock the alchemist talent while being struck by an arrow could develop the stack arrow talent you cannot acquire a talent that directly opposes one you already possess for instance a character cannot be both strong and weak at the same time you can use another mechanic called gods favors to get rid of negative talents interesting itemization in addition to standard items like legendary and unique gear the game introduces cursed items which grant powerful benefits at a cost players can weigh the pros and cons to create interesting builds and there is even a class specifically designed to make the most of these cursed items daynight cycle this game includes a day and night cycle a feature sometimes not present even in some highbudget crpgs nightfall limits visibility making torches essential for exploration theres also a passive talent called night owl that greatly improves nighttime vision even with good visibility it is generally recommended to sleep at night preferably in a village sleeping outdoors risks being rudely interrupted by random monster attacks for example there is a suspicious location where if you go to bed youll discover that its inhabitants are werewolves i went in there fully knowing that there would be werewolves but this is an openworld game you couldve easily stumbled upon that location without prior knowledge the game features several nightime events that keeps things interesting npc routines night is not only for the player but also for npcs various npcs and merchants follow a routine at night shops and homes close their doors taverns become livelier and some merchants can be found enjoying a drink a particularly amusing thing i discovered is that if closely follow a npc into their houses before they lock up for the night you can spend the night chatting with that npc altogether these interactions between npcs and the daynight cycle make the world feel genuinely alive choices and consequences the game offers a slew of choices that shape the story affect character progression through different quest rewards called virtues and impact the world via dynamic events in the base game there are two ways to resolve the conflict of the gods while the expansion adds a third path this only pertains to the main story side quests also feature meaningful choices for example early in the game you are tasked with hunting a werewolf you can uncover which npc is the werewolf and confront them during the day approach them in their transformed state at night or even work with them to deceive the village into believing they are dead the last choice gets the werewolf npc to help you out with another side quest world events world events are mostly random but their occurrence and nature are influenced by several factors such as the number of ingame days that have passed progression in the main storyline the number of player deaths and various player actions or completed side quests for example i once killed an optional superboss called golem mother which triggered a world event announcing that golems across the world had turned hostile i once cleared an area with bear activity the area was taken over by a griffin factions a cool faction system that lets you transform the world in the colors of your preferred faction for example you can side with the goblin faction and help them in their conquests this affects the price of fish you can also fight against friendly factions if you prefer to have some locations fall under the control of your own faction own a house the world of svarogs dream is unlike our own you can actually afford to buy a place here not just one but several homes can be upgraded to include alchemy tables crafting benches additional storage spaces and with the expansion a farm cooking the game features a hunger mechanic staying wellfed regenerates health while out of combat and enables fast travel while im unsure whether starvation can kill you the system never feels intrusive imo you can keep yourself fed by buying food finding food or by cooking you can learn some basic recipes learned in the first town you visit as part of the main quest additional recipes are found through exploration experimentation with ingredient combinations or a chain of side quests given by a chef in one of the towns cooking ingredients can be foraged hunted or purchased alchemy unlike cooking alchemy isnt tied to a core game mechanic potions crafted with alchemy are useful but entirely optional not to mention a lot of potions that you can craft can be found as you explore the world like cooking recipes alchemy recipes can be discovered through exploration or a chain of optional side quests from a specific npc however unlike cooking you cannot experiment with ingredients while cooking experimentation always yields something edible in alchemy it will simply produce a dud crafting you can use upgrade stations to enhance your gear similar to alchemy this is also optional i have beaten the game thrice and have never interacted with this mechanic my thoughts i discovered this game purely by chance while browsing steam and it was an absolute joy to play this hidden gem the reactive world the sense of exploration the unique setting and the sheer variety of mechanics are what made me a fan my post gloss over some mechanics if youre interested in knowing about them you can see the official handbook or the wiki despite the games depth you wont feel overwhelmed by it for the most part approaching it like a standard arpg is sufficient i also highly recommend purchasing the expansion as it enriches the main story with an entirely new branch that offers an alternate solution to the conflict of the gods while introducing several new mechanics the dev ulynxbird hangs out on reddit this is mostly a solodev project with some inputs from others and artwork from his wife

scottish set comic about community trauma and folklore im born and raised in scotland and until recently id never worked in comics at all about six months ago i decided to take a jump and try to get something made anyway im under no illusions this could absolutely fail ive been working on a scottish set supernatural noir comic not because i wanted monsters or spectacle but because i wanted to write about people broken people the kind you grow up knowing here the story is rooted in scottish communities the humour we use when things are grim the closeness we have for our own that stubborn someone has got to do it attitude when things fall apart a lot of the characters are directly inspired by people ive known or worked with over the years i wanted to explore real social issues we deal with here alcoholism drug abuse burnout but also the other side of it community strength how people support each other how folk pull together when theres no other option i grew up hearing stories about what it was like when the docks shut down and that sense of shared survival really stuck with me the folklore and mythology are in there but they are not the focus the monsters mostly exist as pressure a way for the characters to reflect on their own lives and choices ive been trying to build an audience online where i can podcasts social media and places that allow it one thing ive genuinely struggled with is getting this in front of scottish eyes that has been harder than i expected im posting this on the off chance that anyone curious about a story set in communities they would recognise might want to follow along before launch if not no worries if anyone has advice or could point me toward communities groups or spaces that might be interested in this sort of work id appreciate it ill share the link for anyone interested the project isnt live yet it doesnt cost anything to follow the project for those curious

the velvet theory weekly posting rhythm welcome to the velvet theory weekly posting rhythma gentle structure to hold space for presence reflection and conversation this rhythm isnt about rigid content planningits about honoring the natural ebb and flow of energy insight and softness that guides this space each day offers an invitation to explore a different facet of your inner world to show up as you are and to witness the velvet moments unfolding around and within you monday velvet moment reflection start the week with softness and intention prompt a velvet moment that changed me or what softness taught me this weekend tuesday awakening thread pose a deep spiritual question to open reflection prompt what does it feel like when your intuition speaks or what are you unlearning about love right now wednesday mini velvet prompt a micropost to spark quick engagement or journalstyle replies prompt finish this sentence im not who i was because or one thing ive released that changed everything thursday the velvet path teaching pull from your blog and teach a concept in a few lines prompt why softness is not weaknessits strength in its truest form then link to your full blog post friday intuition friday this is your sacred spotlight day let it be expansive post ideas an intuitive nudge i followed that changed something this synchronicity gave me chills what im learning to trustwithout proof am i listening to life or just surviving it invite your community whats your soul saying today saturday heartwide open share open up vulnerably and create space for others to do the same prompt heres what im trusting even without clarity or this week felt heavy heres what im remembering sunday stillness integration a rest post sacred pause or journal prompt prompt what did this week teach me or whats one truth i want to carry into next week this rhythm is here to support not pressure if a post wants to be shared on a monday but arrives on a wednesday instead let it if your intuition says pause pause this is a living breathing cadencea sacred pulse follow what feels aligned share what feels true and remember you dont have to say everything at once you just have to keep showing up one velvet moment at a time

why commercial properties in greater faridabad are getting attention greater faridabad has quietly become one of the most discussed real estate micromarkets in ncr especially when it comes to commercial investments while gurugram and noida have traditionally dominated this segment many investors are now exploring commercial properties in greater faridabad due to better entry pricing and improving infrastructure one of the biggest drivers behind this shift is connectivity the area benefits from nh19 delhimathura road the delhifaridabad skyway and the violet line metro upcoming projects like the fng expressway are expected to further strengthen links with noida and ghaziabad for commercial real estate such road and metro access plays a crucial role in footfall and longterm viability another factor supporting demand is the rapid residential growth in sectors like 75 to 89 as residential societies become more densely populated the need for retail shops clinics offices food outlets and service centers increases naturally this residentialcommercial synergy is one of the main reasons commercial properties in greater faridabad being seen as a practical longterm investment rather than just a speculative one mixeduse developments are also contributing to the areas appeal projects that combine retail entertainment and office spaces tend to attract steady footfall throughout the week not just on weekends locations around sector 79 and nearby corridors are often discussed because they sit close to large housing clusters which helps support businesses operating there from an investment point of view pricing still remains relatively accessible compared to central ncr markets while returns may not be immediate many investors consider this a growthphase market where value appreciation can happen gradually as infrastructure matures this makes commercial properties in greater faridabad suitable for those with a medium to longterm investment horizon that said not every project or location performs the same way some sectors have better visibility and road frontage while others are still waiting for surrounding development anyone considering investment should evaluate factors like existing population density accessibility developer track record and approved land use before committing local real estate consultants and platforms such as gaurav properties often help buyers understand these nuances especially for those unfamiliar with faridabads micromarkets having access to local insights can be useful when assessing which commercial properties in greater faridabad align with specific goalswhether its rental income selfuse or longterm appreciation overall greater faridabad is no longer just a residential extension of ncr with improving infrastructure growing demand and relatively reasonable pricing it is gradually positioning itself as a viable destination for commercial real estate investment it will be interesting to see how the market evolves over the next few years as planned projects and connectivity upgrades are completed

just spent a month exploring portugal solo the beautiful realities and why im already planning my next trip okay so i just wrapped up a full month exploring portugal solo and if youre picturing me constantly sipping vinho verde on a sundrenched terrace looking effortlessly serene well that happened sometimes but honestly the real magic and the real grind was in the moments between those pictureperfect scenes this trip wasnt about finding myself or living an epic adventure it was about getting a genuine feel for a place warts and all and figuring out how to navigate it as a party of one my portugal playbook a month solo route flew into lisbon 10 days trained to porto 7 days bused down to lagos in the algarve 6 days then a final few days back in lisbon before flying out didnt rush it wanted to soak things in rather than tick off a list accommodation a practical mix of airbnbs for more space and kitchen access and wellreviewed hostels for a social buzz when i wanted it lisbon airbnb average 50night offseason shoulder month good deals porto hostel private room 35night lagos hostel dorm 20night transport flights booked well in advance roundtrip from my home city was about 400 trains cp comboios de portugal lisbonporto 30 booked ahead for discount reliable and scenic buses rede expressos portolagos 25 lagoslisbon 20 comfortable enough for longer hauls local lots of walking metrotrams in lisbon grab a viva viagem card and load it up boltuber for late nights or specific areas when my feet gave out food drink this is where i probably spent more than i intended because the food is just that good daily average 3550 a mix of cooking in airbnbs cheap lunch prato do dia and occasional nice dinners coffee essential 150 for a bica pastel de nata daily ritual 120 each no regrets activities mostly walking tours tipbased museum entries 515 each a beginner surf lesson in lagos 45 and just soaking up the atmosphere didnt splurge on many expensive tours total estimated cost excluding international flights roughly 15001800 for the month all in i generally aimed to stay around 5060day the real talk unexpected hugs and headaches now lets cut through the instagram filters for a second solo travel in portugal or anywhere isnt always sunshine and easy living loneliness yeah sometimes there were evenings in a charming restaurant feeling a bit conspicuous with just me and my book but then there were the random hostel chats that turned into dinner plans or the older portuguese couple at a local tasca who just insisted i try their special brandy the key was knowing when to seek company and when to genuinely enjoy my own space language barrier while many people in tourist areas speak english venturing off the beaten path even slightly meant fumbling through obrigado desculpa and lots of pointing it was humbling but also led to some genuine laughs and appreciative smiles a few basic phrases go a long way decision fatigue is real every meal every activity every route its all on you by week three even choosing what pastelaria to get my morning coffee from felt like a major executive decision building in do nothing days or just wandering aimlessly was crucial the hills oh god the hills lisbon and porto are gorgeous but my calves got a serious workout seriously invest in good walking shoes my step count was consistently through the roof my favorite discovery noninstagrammable edition finding a tiny nondescript frutaria in lisbon with the sweetest cheapest oranges ive ever tasted or the quiet unassuming fado bar in alfama where a local just sang their heart out without any pretense completely unbothered by tourists these were the moments that felt truly authentic not just a photo op so yeah im already eyeing flights for next year portugal burrowed its way under my skin not because it was perfect or lifechanging but because it was real beautiful challenging and endlessly interesting it taught me that genuine travel isnt about ticking off sights its about the quiet moments the unexpected connections and the sheer grit of figuring things out on your own if youre planning your first solo trip or just looking for genuine travel insights beyond the glossy brochures come join us over at rsolopassions were a community built on sharing real stories practical tips and honest experiences no filters just fellow travelers navigating the world one solo adventure at a time

space exploration is the physical investigation of outer space by uncrewed robotic space probes and through human spaceflight while the observation of objects in space known as astronomy predates reliable recorded history it was the development of large and relatively efficient rockets during the midtwentieth century that allowed physical space exploration to become a reality common rationales for exploring space include advancing scientific research national prestige uniting different nations ensuring the future survival of humanity and developing military and strategic advantages against other countries the early era of space exploration was driven by a space race in which the soviet union and the united states vied to demonstrate their technological superiority landmarks of this era include the launch of the first humanmade object to orbit earth the soviet unions sputnik 1 on 4 october 1957 and the first moon landing by the american apollo 11 mission on 20 july 1969 the soviet space program achieved many of the first milestones including the first living being in orbit in 1957 the first human spaceflight yuri gagarin aboard vostok 1 in 1961 the first spacewalk by alexei leonov on 18 march 1965 the first automatic landing on another celestial body in 1966 and the launch of the first space station salyut 1 in 1971 in the 1970s focus shifted from oneoff flights to renewable hardware such as the space shuttle program and from competition to cooperation the foremost example being the international space station iss built between 1998 and 2011 the 2000s brought advancements in the national spaceexploration programs of china the european union japan and india the 2010s saw the rise of the private space industry in earnest with the development of private launch vehicles space capsules and satellite manufacturing in the 2020s the two primary global programs gaining traction are moonfocused the chineseled international lunar research station and the usled artemis program with its plan to build the lunar gateway and the artemis base camp each with a set of international partners history of exploration first telescopes the first telescope is said to have been invented in 1608 in the netherlands by an eyeglass maker named hans lippershey but their first recorded use in astronomy was by galileo galilei in 1609 in 1668 isaac newton built his own reflecting telescope the first fully functional telescope of this kind and a landmark for future developments due to its superior features over the previous galilean telescope a string of discoveries in the solar system and beyond followed then and in the next centuries the mountains of the moon the phases of venus the main satellites of jupiter and saturn the rings of saturn many comets the asteroids the new planets uranus and neptune and many more satellites the orbiting astronomical observatory 2 was the first space telescope launched 1968 but the launch of the hubble space telescope in 1990 set a milestone as of 1 december 2022 there were 5284 confirmed exoplanets discovered the milky way is estimated to contain 100400 billion stars and more than 100 billion planets there are at least 2 trillion galaxies in the observable universe hd1 is the most distant known object from earth reported as 334 billion lightyears away first outer space flights mw 18014 was a german v2 rocket test launch that took place on 20 june 1944 at the peenemnde army research center in peenemnde it was the first humanmade object to reach outer space attaining an apogee of 176 kilometers which is well above the krmn line it was a vertical test launch although the rocket reached space it did not reach orbital velocity and therefore returned to earth in an impact becoming the first suborbital spaceflight in 1949 the bumperwac reached an altitude of 393 kilometres 244 mi becoming the first humanmade object to enter space according to nasa first object in orbit the first successful orbital launch was of the soviet uncrewed sputnik 1 satellite 1 mission on 4 october 1957 the satellite weighed about 83 kg 183 lb and is believed to have orbited earth at a height of about 250 km 160 mi it had two radio transmitters 20 and 40 mhz which emitted beeps that could be heard by radios around the globe analysis of the radio signals was used to gather information about the electron density of the ionosphere while temperature and pressure data were encoded in the duration of radio beeps the results indicated that the satellite was not punctured by a meteoroid sputnik 1 was launched by an r7 rocket it burned up upon reentry on 3 january 1958 first human outer space flight the first successful human spaceflight was vostok 1 east 1 carrying the 27yearold russian cosmonaut yuri gagarin on 12 april 1961 the spacecraft completed one orbit around the globe lasting about 1 hour and 48 minutes gagarins flight resonated around the world it was a demonstration of the advanced soviet space program and it opened an entirely new era in space exploration human spaceflight first astronomical body space explorations the first artificial object to reach another celestial body was luna 2 which reached the moon in 1959 the first soft landing on another celestial body was performed by luna 9 landing on the moon on 3 february 1966 luna 10 became the first artificial satellite of the moon entering in a lunar orbit on 3 april 1966 the first crewed landing on another celestial body was performed by apollo 11 on 20 july 1969 landing on the moon there have been a total of six spacecraft with humans landing on the moon starting from 1969 to the last human landing in 1972 the first interplanetary flyby was the 1961 venera 1 flyby of venus though the 1962 mariner 2 was the first flyby of venus to return data closest approach 34773 kilometers pioneer 6 was the first satellite to orbit the sun launched on 16 december 1965 the other planets were first flown by in 1965 for mars by mariner 4 1973 for jupiter by pioneer 10 1974 for mercury by mariner 10 1979 for saturn by pioneer 11 1986 for uranus by voyager 2 1989 for neptune by voyager 2 in 2015 the dwarf planets ceres and pluto were orbited by dawn and passed by new horizons respectively this accounts for flybys of each of the eight planets in the solar system the sun the moon and ceres and pluto two of the five recognized dwarf planets the first interplanetary surface mission to return at least limited surface data from another planet was the 1970 landing of venera 7 which returned data to earth for 23 minutes from venus in 1975 venera 9 was the first to return images from the surface of another planet returning images from venus in 1971 the mars 3 mission achieved the first soft landing on mars
